The average combined cost per HH was highest for DWL ($13.57) followed by EM ($5.19) and ITN ($3.62) Discussion The VL Elimination Program in the Indian sub-continent recommends sand fly reduction through integrated vector control management (IVM) which optimally requires more than one vector control method [2]. IRS is widely used by the program but other vector control methods like EM, ITN and DWL are not. To date, only two RCTs in the Indian sub-continent for sand fly control had been carried out, and one of these two studies included sites in all three coun- tries [4,6].
